mapper.select: select t.ticket_id, t.title, t.description, t.expiring_date, t.is_used, u.user_name as creator_name from tickets t left join m_user u on t.creator_id = u.id where t.owner_id = #{ownerId} and ( (t.is_used = false and t.expiring_date >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) or (t.is_used = true and t.updated_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 year') )

select t.ticket_id, t.title, t.description, t.expiring_date, t.is_used, u.user_name as owner_name from tickets t left join m_user u on t.owner_id = u.id where t.creator_id = #{creatorId} and (t.is_used = false or t.updated_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 year')
mapper.update: update tickets set is_used=true, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where ticket_id=#{ticketId} and owner_id=#{ownerId} and expiring_date>= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP and is_used is false
mapper.insert: insert into tickets (title, description, expiring_date, owner_id, creator_id, is_used, inserted_at, updated_at) values (#{title}, #{description}, #{expiringDate}, #{ownerId}, #{creatorId}, false, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
